content:
maria: Quick sync: SignalBridge private cutover for Orenda — egress gating, air-gap cert import, and final CR approvals. Need owners for each. TL;DR: we need egress fallback, cert import runbook, and CR reviews by EOD Wed. @aj @samir @nisha

aj: I’ll own egress fallback plan. Will validate proxy routing and SNI. ETA tomorrow noon. @leo can you confirm firewall NAT rule IDs?

leo: Confirmed NAT IDs: nat-od-09 and nat-od-10 in staging. Will push to prod list after the dry-run. Can we get an explicit list of allowed IPs from Orenda?

maria: Orenda gave two CIDR blocks in the support ticket: 10.240.0.0/22 and 52.48.12.0/29. I'll paste the ticket snippet in a sec.

maria: (paste) ```Allowed egress: 10.240.0.0/22, 52.48.12.0/29. No outbound DNS to 8.8.8.8; must use internal resolver.```

samir: For air-gap cert import, I'll run the importer script (onprem/cert-bulk-import.sh). Need the signed chain files from Orenda and SRE access to the bastion. @sre-oncall can you grant the key?

sre-oncall: Granting bastion access for samir until 2025-01-10. Added to temp group. Please provide the exact bastion username you'll use.

samir: using ubuntu@orenda-bastion-1. Also, heads up  the importer expects certs in PKCS#12, not PEM. I'll convert if they send PEM.

nisha: I'll own CR reviews for the customer-specific vars in infra repo. Pls tag me on the PR. Small ask: don't merge until I've signed off on the kms policy. 

maria: @nisha PR is up: https://git.redwood/infra/ops/merge_requests/482  note kms-policy change and an extra secret mount. @aj can you attach the egress smoke test in CI?

aj: Added smoke CI job `smoke/private-egress` to the MR. It runs a curl to the allowed IPs via the customer proxy and checks HTTP 200. Job will run in a dedicated runner.

leo: One blocker  our runner uses shared egress today. We need a runner inside the customer's VPC or a runner with NAT mapping. Ops infra: can we spin ephemeral runner in staging VPC?

deploy-bot: Created ephemeral runner `runner-orenda-ephemeral-03` in staging with NAT mapping. Token expires in 12h. Link: https://ci.redwood/runners/runner-orenda-ephemeral-03

maria: Awesome. Remaining items: (1) Orenda to send PKCS#12 certs (2) KMS access review (3) Firewall rules applied and verified (4) CR merged. I'll coordinate canary window  target Fri 03:00 UTC. Anyone object?

samir: Friday 03:00 UTC works for me. I'll be on the runbook.

nisha: OK. I'll do one final KMS check during canary and sign off after smoke passes.

aj: I'll be oncall the rollout window to toggle fallback if needed.

maria: Thanks team. Quick action items summary pinned: ```- aj: egress fallback & CI smoke (ETA 24h)
- leo: firewall NAT & IP confirmation
- samir: cert import runbook + bastion ops
- nisha: CR + KMS signoff
- mari: canary schedule & customer comms
``` Will follow up with a meeting if any kernel blockers pop.

maria: Pinging Orenda support contact to request PKCS#12 and final IP confirmation.

deploy-bot: Orenda ticket #2381 updated: customer uploaded certs (pem).

samir: got the notification. I'll convert PEM -> PKCS12 and upload to S3-temp. Posting link in thread.

samir: (link) s3://orenda-temp/certs/orenda_pkcs12.zip (expires in 48h)  I'll DM creds to @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: Received creds and started import. Will report back on any errors.

sre-oncall: Import completed with one warning about chain order  fixed. Verified service responds to internal resolver only. Smoke test pending CI run.

aj: Smoke job passed on ephemeral runner: 3/3 endpoints OK. Marking egress verified.

maria: Great. Closing pre-cutover checklist. I'll update the cutover calendar invite. Thanks all :tada:
